title: Elden Ring vs Dark Souls 3: $1 vs $1.92 an Hour
caption:
Same $59.99 on Steam. Elden Ring takes about 60 hours to beat, Dark Souls 3 about 31 (HowLongToBeat main story): $1 an hour vs $1.92. Go 100% and it's 44¢ vs 60¢. Our own math.
Which one gave you more for your money? And which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to your Dark Souls friend: same $59.99, but Elden Ring gives you 2x the hours ($1 vs $1.92 an hour).
